subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 21, 2026
body:
**Critical PHP Security Update Coming: Protect Your AcreetionOS System**

A critical PHP security update is scheduled to be released on October 21, 2026, at 14:00 UTC. This update addresses a high-stakes security vulnerability that could potentially compromise the security of your AcreetionOS system. We urge all users to take immediate action to ensure their systems are updated as soon as possible.

**Community News**

The AcreetionOS community has been actively working on various projects, including the development of new features and bug fixes. Our community members have been contributing to the project's growth and success, and we appreciate their hard work and dedication.

**Practical Tip:**

To stay up-to-date with the latest security updates and news, we recommend enabling the "Security" feed in your AcreetionOS desktop environment. This will allow you to receive notifications and updates on the latest security patches and vulnerabilities affecting your system. To enable the Security feed, follow these steps:

1. Open the AcreetionOS Settings app.
2. Navigate to the "Desktop" section.
3. Click on the "Feeds" tab.
4. Select the "Security" feed from the list.
5. Click "Enable" to activate the feed.

By following these simple steps, you'll be able to stay informed about the latest security updates and ensure your AcreetionOS system remains secure and up-to-date.
